decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY preserving the existing non-Webflow root-domain host. The source does not independently establish a client-approved subdomain or any further change.
The existing product host on the root domain does not change the selected Webflow Basic plan or the cost-selection rule for the marketing site.
The root-domain hosting fact does not alter the contact-page headline or body copy.
The hosting clarification does not change the landing page's content composition, image quantity, or screenshot-selection policy.
The product's existing root-domain host does not affect the requested Loom site-editing instruction artifact.
The hosting clarification does not change the requirement to transfer the Webflow website to the client's workspace.
The reference to the product concerns domain routing and does not alter the hero visual's format, controls, gallery, or mobile-phone presentation.
The root-domain hosting fact does not change the contact form's submission recipients or lead-delivery behavior.
